title: CRATE — Containerized Attacks & Testable Exploits
description: Containerized Repository of Attacks and Testable Exploits. A set of containerized exploits for testing security hardening measures written for 4th year honours project at University of Edinburgh.

title: pwdtools-macgpu — Metal GPU MD5 Cracker
description: GPU-accelerated MD5 hash cracker using Apple's Metal framework, achieving 2.6GH/s to 5.1GH/s throughput on Apple Silicon hardware.

title: OCRAlgebra — Neural Network Character Recognition
description: Neural Network built from scratch without external ML libraries to perform optical character recognition on algebraic symbols.

title: pwdtools — Password Security & Analysis Suite
description: A comprehensive suite of command-line tools for managing password security, entropy evaluation, and hash analysis.

title: pendulum — Genetic Algorithm Neural Network
description: A pendulum balancing game paired with a neural network trained via genetic algorithms to achieve high scores.

title: Seam-Carving — Content-Aware Image Resizing
description: An implementation of the seminal Seam Carving algorithm for content-aware image resizing using dynamic programming.
